auth.title: Sign in to the admin console
auth.emailHint: We send a one-time code to your email address. No password needed.
auth.codeHint: If {email} has an account, a code is on its way. Enter it here.
auth.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.

noAccess.title: No operator access
noAccess.text: Your account is not staff at any operator yet. Ask an owner of your organisation to add you.

form.oneLanguageRequired: Fill in at least one language.

visibilityHint.public: Anyone with the link sees the map, stops and bus position.
visibilityHint.invited_map: Riders with an invite code see the map if their audience may; others see arrival times.
visibilityHint.invited_eta: Riders with an invite code see arrival times only. No map, no stop locations.

contrast.invalid: Enter a colour as six hex digits, for example 1E6FD9.

today.title: Today
today.noPosition: No position from {vehicle} during its trip.
today.noInstances: No trips created for today yet
today.noInstancesText: The engine creates today's trips from the schedule and tracks them. When it has not run yet, the list below shows what the schedule says.

routes.title: Routes and stops
routes.name: Name
routes.emptyText: Create a route here. Recording a route with the vehicle app (stops and times from one drive) comes in a later version.
routes.noPatternsText: Stops and times come from recording the route or from a GTFS import. Both are coming in a later version.
routes.offsetsHint: Times are minutes after the trip starts.
routes.mapFailed: The map could not be shown.
routes.noShape: No line drawn for this pattern yet.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.noTrips: No trips for this pattern yet.
schedule.noPatternsText: Trips belong to a route pattern (its stops and times). Patterns come from recording a route.
schedule.needCalendar: Create a calendar first: every trip runs on the days of a calendar.

trip.copyHint: Same stops and minutes as the {time} trip, with a new start time.
trip.deleteText: The {time} trip and its records for today and later are deleted.

calendars.name: Name
calendars.endBeforeStart: Must be on or after the start date.
calendars.holidaysPending: National holidays are applied once the holiday table is available.

preview.holidayNote: National holidays are not taken into account yet.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.name: Name
vehicles.traccarHint: Set by the Buspilot team, so no one can attach another operator's tracker.

audiences.title: Audiences and invite codes
audiences.subtitle: Who may see which routes. Only member counts are shown, never who the members are.
audiences.name: Name
audiences.emptyText: An audience is a group of riders with the same access, for example "Parents morning route A". Riders join with an invite code.
audiences.routesHint: Arrival times only, or also the map. The map needs a route visibility that allows it.

access.mapNeedsVisibility: The route shows arrival times only (visibility).

audiences.deleteText: Its invite codes stop working and its {n} members lose access. This cannot be undone.

invite.title: Invite codes
invite.subtitle: Riders join this audience with a code. Codes are stored hashed and shown only once.
invite.label: Label
invite.labelHint: For you, e.g. "Letter to parents, April". Shown on the sheet.
invite.createFailed: The code could not be created.
invite.shownOnce: This is the only time the code is shown. Print or copy it now.
invite.copyFailed: Copying is not available. Write the code down.
invite.closeText: The code cannot be shown again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
invite.revokeText: The code stops working at once.
invite.revokeMemberships: Also remove riders who joined with this code
invite.expiryInPast: The expiry date is in the past.

sheet.title: How to join
sheet.step1: Open the Buspilot app (or scan the QR code with your phone camera).
sheet.step2: Scan the QR code or enter the code {code}.
sheet.step3: Choose your stop to get a notice before the bus arrives.
sheet.privacy: No name, email or phone number needed. Keep this code within your group.

news.title: News
news.expiryBeforePublish: Must be after the publish time.
news.sendPushHint: Members who allow notifications get one when the post is published.
news.translationLater: Machine translation comes in a later version.

settings.title: Operator settings
settings.languagesHint: Texts for riders can be written in these languages.
settings.logoHint: https:// address of a square logo. Uploading comes later.
settings.previewHint: How a rider card looks in the app.
